### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Pin the workflow's version once for every image and chart job](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3319) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Every image and chart job of a CircleCI run uses the version resolved once at its start, so a release tagged during the run no longer fails the chart push on mismatched image and chart versions.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.27.14...v3.27.15
